name: 53103 · Big Bend, WI
findings: ZIP 53103 (Big Bend) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53103 (Big Bend) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
